name: manual_9644a2
claim: Never pass a secret as an argument to a PowerShell function whose name collides with a built-in alias (for example h for Get-History): the binding error echoes the argument. List variable names only and compare secrets by fingerprint, never by value.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-23: an env-file grep and then an alias collision each printed secret values into a session transcript, which forced rotation guidance.

rationale: 2026-10-23: an env-file grep and then an alias collision each printed secret values into a session transcript, which forced rotation guidance.
